title: Zero-Trust Security Hardening, Dynamic Rate Limiting & OWASP Top 10 Enterprise Shield (Strict CSP Nonces, API Key Vaulting, Request Sanitization)
spec:
# DIR-040: Zero-Trust Security Hardening, Dynamic Rate Limiting & OWASP Top 10 Enterprise Shield

## 1. Executive Context & Objectives (Enhancement Mandate)
As ResumePilotAI scales to serve thousands of candidates, enterprise hiring teams, and AI-driven workflows, it must maintain an impenetrable security posture. Defense-in-depth principles require continuous enforcement of zero-trust architecture, automated mitigation of OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, intelligent brute-force and DDoS rate limiting, and cryptographic secret vaulting.

This directive mandates a 10/10 comprehensive **Zero-Trust Enterprise Security Hardening**, implementing strict Content Security Policy (CSP) headers, dynamic IP/Token rate limiting with Redis/in-memory fallback, automated SQL/XSS input sanitization, and secure credential handling.

## 2. Architecture Directives
1. **Enterprise Content Security Policy (CSP) & Security Headers**:
   - Configure Helmet with strict CSP: default-src 'self', script-src with cryptographic nonces for inline scripts, connect-src restricted to approved API, Firebase, and payment gateways.
   - Enforce HSTS (Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload).
   - Set X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN (or DENY on auth routes), X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin, Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(self).

2. **Dynamic Sliding-Window Rate Limiting**:
   - Route-specific rate limits:
     - Auth routes (/api/auth/login, /api/auth/register): 5 requests / minute per IP.
     - AI generation routes (/api/generate-*): 20 requests / minute per user token.
     - Public search & browse routes: 60 requests / minute per IP.
     - General API routes: 120 requests / minute per user token.
   - Return standard headers: RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining, RateLimit-Reset, Retry-After.
   - Expose security challenge or CAPTCHA on suspicious burst traffic.

3. **OWASP Top 10 Input Sanitization & Defense**:
   - Universal request sanitizer middleware: recursive stripping of prototype pollution (__proto__, constructor), XSS script tags, and SQL injection syntax across req.body, req.query, and req.params.
   - Parameterized queries enforced across all MariaDB operations; zero raw string concatenation in SQL statements.
   - Path traversal defense on file uploads and static asset serving.

4. **Cryptographic Secret Vaulting & Auditing**:
   - Automated startup linter verifying that no secret keys (JWT secrets, DB passwords, AI API keys) contain default or placeholder values in production mode.
   - Automated redaction of secrets in application logs, error traces, and client responses.

## 3. Acceptance Criteria
1. Security headers audit (securityheaders.com / automated scanner) achieves an 'A+' rating.
2. Brute force attempts on auth routes trigger HTTP 429 Too Many Requests after threshold.
3. Automated penetration tests verify complete protection against XSS, SQLi, and prototype pollution.
4. CSP blocks unapproved external script injection while permitting legitimate app bundles.
5. All sensitive credentials remain encrypted at rest and masked in memory/logs.
6. Zero regressions in legitimate candidate, recruiter, or enterprise workflows.

## 4. Strict Invariants
1. Rate limiting must never lock out verified SuperAdmins on legitimate management tasks.
2. Security middleware must execute in sub-2ms per request without noticeable latency.
3. Never store or log plaintext user passwords or session tokens.
4. Input sanitization must preserve valid candidate resume text (e.g. programming code samples).
invariants: Security headers must achieve A+ rating without breaking legitimate integrations
Zero plaintext credentials, keys, or passwords logged or exposed
Rate limiting must return RFC standard headers with proper reset times
Input sanitization must sanitize malicious vectors without corrupting valid candidate text
acceptanceCriteria: Enterprise security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options) fully configured and tested
Dynamic rate limiter blocks brute force and abuse with HTTP 429 response
Penetration testing verifies zero vulnerability to XSS, SQLi, or prototype pollution
Secret vaulting linter validates configuration integrity at application boot
All security invariants verified through automated security test suite
